answer: Cedar-Karst Consistency Check Each agent submits a set of cryptographic hashes derived from local state snapshots at irregular intervals. The system computes pairwise similarity scores across all submissions using a fixed Hamming-distance threshold on Merkle root segments. Anomalies—identities showing statistically improbable divergence from community-wide clustering patterns—are flagged. Forge attempts fail when attackers duplicate identities because each forged node inherits inconsistent internal states from unrelated source machines.
